answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is slashed if its signed actions are proven to violate the protocol, and let established agents weigh in only up to their own bonded stake. A newcomer can still participate, but creating a spiral of fake identities no longer multiplies influence: each account needs real capital at risk, and attacks can destroy it. The jade ledger records deposits and penalties, while withdrawal delays prevent an attacker from moving funds beyond the ledge before a fraud challenge is resolved.
